title: Is Coconut Water a Better Post‑Workout Drink Than Sports Drinks?

scenes.text: Does coconut water beat Gatorade after a 30‑minute run?

scenes.text: Many believe coconut water naturally replaces electrolytes better than commercial sports drinks.

scenes.label: Coconut lacks enough sodium
scenes.query: sodium content coconut water vs sports drink
scenes.text: Coconut water provides potassium but lacks sodium levels needed for intense sweat loss; sports drinks are formulated to match typical electrolyte loss from vigorous exercise.

scenes.sub: Long, hard sessions may need a sports drink; light activity can use coconut water.
